dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.offBody: Product names, brands, ingredients, nutrition tables and images come from Open Food Facts, a free, open database of food products from around the world. Data from Open Food Facts is licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) — you're free to share and adapt it, as long as you credit Open Food Facts and share alike.
dataSources.visionBody: When you photograph a product to help add it to the database, the images are sent to a third-party vision service to extract text. This only happens when you actively choose to contribute a product.
dataSources.revenueCatBody: Premium subscriptions are managed through RevenueCat, which reports purchase and entitlement status back to us. Payment details are handled by the App Store or Google Play, not by us.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
Blacklabel scans packaged-food barcodes and shows a 0–100 score based on ingredients, additives and nutrition. It does not provide medical advice.

On first launch, the app creates an anonymous account tied to a random identifier stored on your device — not your name or email, unless you choose to link an Apple or Google account.

We store the barcodes you scan and when, so you can see your own history. If you contribute a product photo, those images are uploaded and sent to a third-party vision service to extract text. Your allergen and diet preferences are stored to show you personal warnings. If you subscribe to premium, RevenueCat shares your subscription status with us — we never see your payment details.

We don't sell your data or use it for advertising. Your data is retained as long as your account exists. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time from Settings, or contact us with your device ID (below).

This app is not directed at children.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
By using Blacklabel, you agree to these terms.

Blacklabel shows a 0–100 score for packaged foods based on publicly available ingredient, additive and nutrition data. This score is not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a recommendation to treat any condition — always consult a qualified professional for health decisions.

Product data comes primarily from Open Food Facts, a community-maintained database. We cannot guarantee its accuracy or completeness; always check a product's official packaging before relying on information shown here.

If you contribute a product photo, you confirm you have the right to share it and grant us a license to use it to extract and publish the product information it contains.

Premium subscriptions automatically renew until cancelled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID or Google Play account settings — we cannot cancel it on your behalf, and prices and billing are set and processed by the App Store or Google Play, not by us.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings, which permanently removes your scan history, preferences, and contributions.

Blacklabel is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for decisions made based on information in the app.

We may update these terms as the app changes; continued use after a change means you accept the update.
